findings.finding: The post-merger distribution is unfinished and undated: former VerifyMe holders (who took the $1.50 special dividend payable 10/2) and newly free sellers (10% of the legacy restricted shares released 9/30, resigned directors such as Goldberg with a 37,366-share Form 144) keep supplying a thin float, as they have for eight sessions, and nothing in the record says that supply is spent by 10/13.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Not an event: the supply is continuous and was active on every session since 9/22, so it lands on 10/13 as on every prior day; it is filed small because it has no date and today's volume (0.43x) says the pace has slowed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Over the post-merger slide the next session after a fall went +10.58 (9/22), +3.14 (9/25), +10.32 (9/29), -2.53 (10/01), -15.34 (10/08), -9.96 (10/09): the most recent two continued, the earlier three bounced (baseline history.events).
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the fall to date but not the remaining supply: only 10% of ~10.2m restricted shares is free, and the free float (old VerifyMe ~1.43m, Maxim's 361k, released legacy shares, accelerated insider awards) is still being rotated; if the seller were finished, today's fall would not have come on a day with no news.
